subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broader iOS first-run connection-path chooser on top of the current main onboarding stack, narrow it to Tailscale/security copy, or let the newer current-main onboarding work stand?
rationale: The branch conflicts with later maintainer-visible onboarding and gateway setup work, and the remaining decision is product/security direction for the first-run iOS setup flow rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Rebase and adopt the chooser
options.body: Port the useful Tailscale/remote chooser behavior onto current main while preserving existing setup-link staging, reachable-route probing, credential scoping, and branded typography.

options.title: Narrow to Tailscale guidance
options.body: Keep current main's QR/manual onboarding structure and only extract the raw 100.x block plus MagicDNS/Tailscale Serve copy if maintainers want that smaller change.

options.title: Pause in favor of current main
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged if current onboarding refreshes and related open items are the preferred path for iOS gateway setup UX.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt the chooser
recommendation.body: Port the useful Tailscale/remote chooser behavior onto current main while preserving existing setup-link staging, reachable-route probing, credential scoping, and branded typography.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS gateway setup, Tailnet route, and credential-boundary work make this the strongest available owner for the product/security direction.
